2123189128359817438.en_summary: Great to be featured in Reuters today sharing my thoughts on $NVDA muted post-earnings reaction. Market wanted clarity on margins, financing and leadership and the call confirmed Q4 as the margin bottom with 73% in FY28, partly addressed financing through its neocloud conditions but left leadership unresolved. So we got progress on two of three concerns but just not enough to move the stock much.
2123189128359817438.zh_summary: 很高興今日被路透報道，分享我對NVDA業績後反應平淡的看法。市場希望在利潤率、融資及領導層方面獲得清晰度，電話會議確認Q4為利潤率底部，FY28為73%，部分通過其新雲條件解決融資問題，但領導層未解決。因此我們在三個擔憂中取得兩個進展，但不足以大幅推動股價。
